name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_<domain=chapter_intro>_<descriptor=metadata_table>. Reflects data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue. The dimension (26) is intentionally not in the name and need not be. Accurately describes the per-chapter intro/transition metadata table.
purpose: Per-chapter (1..26) intro/transition metadata table: chapter category, special-hotkey arming state + scancode, and the three shop inventory arrays (weapons/items/mystery).
logic_summary: 806-byte const table = 26 entries x 31-byte (0x1F) stride at 0x6238D..0x626B2. fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry returns &table[chapter_id-1] (base + (id-1)*0x1F) as chapter_intro_metadata_entry*. Seven chapter-intro/transition callers read individual fields. Shop arrays (pWeapons[12]@+3, pItems[8]@+15, pMystery[8]@+23) are surfaced byte-by-byte with 0xFF as empty-slot/terminator by fd2_load_chapter_party_roster. Battle chapters 22..24 entries are all-zero.
datatype: chapter_intro_metadata_entry[26] (Ghidra); emitted as flat const uint8[26*31] in src (byte-identical to the 31-byte struct layout, since every consumer reads through byte/char casts).
element_semantics: Each 31-byte entry (chapter_intro_metadata_entry): +0 bCategory (story-chapter category code 0/1/2); +1 bHotkey_state (chapter_transition_state value arming the special commit hotkey); +2 bHotkey_scancode (keyboard scancode for that hotkey); +3 pWeapons[12] (weapons-shop item ids, 0xFF=empty); +15 pItems[8] (items-shop item ids); +23 pMystery[8] (mystery-shop item ids).
notes: src comment (chtab3.c lines 36-50) verified accurate, concise, ASCII, final-conclusion style; kept unchanged. Verified vs Ghidra: struct chapter_intro_metadata_entry size 31, fields +0/+1/+2/+3(12)/+15(8)/+23(8) match exactly; decompiled accessor fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry @0x4e4b9 confirms base 0x6238D + (id-1)*0x1F. read_memory chapter-1 bytes match src line 52 byte-for-byte. Only xref to 0x6238D is the DATA read in the accessor (no writers) => const confirmed. Ghidra data plate at 0x6238D was empty; created PLATE_COMMENT via Java API (set_plate_via_java_api) reflecting src conclusion (used Ghidra struct field names pWeapons/pItems/pMystery to match the live struct). Only src/ change this shard introduces is none (comment kept); staged set is just this shard file.
